summary: Teams of 2-4 students create and present a comprehensive, data-driven global marketing plan for EcoSphere, an AI platform by a fictional European climate-tech startup. The plan must include market research, target market analysis, pricing strategies, and integrated promotional strategies, and be submitted as a formatted PDF before the deadline. Teams present their plan to judges, answer questions, and are scored on both their written submission and oral presentation.
time_limits: No more than three (3) minutes setup
No more than ten (10) minutes oral presentation
No more than five (5) minutes judges’ questions
submission_requirements: Submit one combined PDF file containing the Marketing Plan with Title Page, Table of Contents, Works Cited formatted according to the Style & Reference Manual, BPA Release Form(s), and AI Usage and Documentation Form
Marketing Plan must not exceed ten (10) pages single-sided (Title Page, Table of Contents, and Works Cited are not included in the ten (10) page limit)
Marketing Plan must follow the Marketing Plan format (Sections I-X) in the Style & Reference Manual
Materials must follow BPA Graphic Standards and make proper use of the BPA logo and/or organization’s name
presubmit_items: Marketing Plan with the Title Page and Table of Contents
deadlines: National Deadline: April 1, 2027, 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time
what_to_bring: Supporting materials (e.g., research charts, brochures, etc.) for each round of presentations
One single-sided laptop, notebook, or tablet for presentation
Optional: Product displays and props (product samples and promotional items), prepared posters, flip charts, easels, or graphs in presentation
competencies: Develop a comprehensive, data-driven global marketing plan
Conduct and communicate marketing research and insights
Define, segment, and analyze domestic and global target markets
Develop and justify value-based pricing strategies
Apply customer relationship management (CRM) and customer engagement strategies
Design integrated marketing campaigns across digital, social, traditional, and experiential platforms
Collaborate effectively in diverse, cross-functional global marketing teams
Deliver compelling, data-backed presentations using interactive and multimedia formats
Apply ethical, legal, and socially responsible marketing practices

rubric.criterion: Team followed the Copyright and/or Fair Use Guidelines and Artificial Intelligence Usage & Citation Policy.
Marketing Plan did not exceed ten (10) pages single-sided. The Title Page, Table of Contents, and Works Cited are not included in the ten (10) page limit.

Team submitted one (1) combined PDF file containing their Marketing Plan to include the Title Page, Table of Contents, Works Cited formatted according to the Style & Reference Manual, BPA Release Form(s), and AI Usage and Documentation Form.

rubric.description: The executive summary is clear, concise, and generates strong interest.
Goals are very clear and realistic.
Target market is precisely defined with demographics.
Pricing strategy is detailed, including profit margins and break-even analysis.
Extensive and relevant research on trends.
Success metrics are exceptionally clear, highly realistic, and well-defined.
Plan is exceptionally well-organized, concise, and thoroughly complete.
Contains very few or no grammar or spelling errors.

rubric.criterion: Team followed the Copyright and/or Fair Use Guidelines and the Artificial Intelligence Usage & Citation Policy.

rubric.description: Team maintains good eye contact, uses appropriate gestures and body language, and varies their tone and pace adequately.
Presentation content flows adequately, and each team member's role is clear and integrated into the presentation. Transitions between speakers and/or points are smooth.
Presentation demonstrates a good understanding of the topic and includes relevant and accurate information.
Responses are detailed, insightful, and effectively address the judges' questions.
At least two original team members were present during the presentation.
Setup lasted no longer than three (3) minutes, and the presentation lasted no more than ten (10) minutes.

judging_notes: AI Policy Level 2 Permitted with Citation
Only one (1) team member should complete the submission
Carry-in and setup of equipment must be done solely by the team within the time allotted
No Internet access will be provided on-site at NLC; however, teams may provide their own access to be used only for their presentation to the judges
Finals may be part of the competition
Judges’ comments will be returned digitally through the online judging system at the national level
Materials submitted for technical judging will not be returned and will not be available at NLC
Props and/or additional items shall not be used as a basis for scoring
Presentation will be stopped at ten (10) minutes
eligibility_notes: Any secondary contestant may enter this judged team event
A team will consist of 2-4 contestants
Teams must be registered for the national competition before the submission deadline and compete in both parts of the event to be ranked
Entries that do not follow the provided topic or the Copyright and/or Fair Use Guidelines and the Artificial Intelligence Usage & Citation Policy will be disqualified
Each state is allowed three (3) entries
